---
id: env.def.you-your
type: definition
heading: You, Your
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

- the named insured and its subsidiaries;
- any past, present or future director, officer, partner or employee of an entity in the first point, while acting in that capacity for the business; and
- any person or entity that you are required by a written contract entered into before the pollution condition began to include as an insured, but only for liability arising from covered operations or a covered location, and only to the extent the contract requires.
